name: Pride IF
divergenceSummary: Subaru never screams for help or summons Reinhard in the slum alleyway. Loop after loop, he casts away his moral conscience, executing the thugs himself and forging a bloody assassination pact with Bowel Hunter Elsa.
headline: The Sin Archbishop of Pride
description: Subaru never cries for help in the alleyway. Forming a sinister pact with Elsa and Meili, he incinerates the royal capital to crown Emilia as king.

events.name: The Unbroken Silence of the Slum Alleyway
events.description: Refusing to summon Reinhard, Subaru loops dozens of times until he ambushes and slaughters the alleyway thugs, presenting their remains to an intrigued Elsa.

events.name: The Blood Covenant with Elsa and Meili
events.description: Subaru leverages Return by Death's infinite foresight to supply Elsa and Meili with perfect targets, forging an unbreakable and sinister partnership.

events.name: Annihilation of Sloth: Slaying Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
events.description: Subaru ambushes the Sloth division, burning their underground tunnels and crushing Petelgeuse to proclaim himself the true Sin Archbishop of Pride.

events.name: The Systematic Ruin of the Four Royal Camps
events.description: Through engineered disasters, poisonings, and calculated terror, Subaru systematically destroys every rival candidate until only Emilia remains standing.

events.name: The Great Incineration of the Royal Capital
events.description: Subaru unleashes magical wildfire across all twelve quarters of the capital, turning the city into a blazing pedestal to force Reinhard into despair.

events.name: The Fall of the Sword Saint's Soul & Emilia's Throne
events.description: Subaru dies smiling at Emilia's feet, taking the blame for every horror in the world so that she ascends the throne hailed as the pure savior who slew Pride.
